measured_for: Accra, high-end neighbourhoods (Cantonments, East Legon, Airport Residential Area), high-end two-bedroom apartment, annual rent divided by 12
note: THIN and high-end segment: $26,299 a year divided by 12. Asking rents seen on Meqasa for the same areas run GH₵13,000 to 30,000 a month (Airport Residential) and $1,800 to 2,500 (East Legon), so the figure is plausible for where a foreign couple would live, but it is not a median of all two-bed flats. Mid-market Accra is far cheaper (Africanvestor models GH₵4,000 a month; Ghana-wide GH₵3,800). Quoted in US dollars, as many Accra expatriate rents are.
